<div style="text-align: center; font-size: x-large; padding: 1em;">'''Welcome to the {{SITENAME}}!'''</div>

Magicraft is a Roguelike game that uses a variety of spells to match unimaginable spell effects, and the construction of ultra-high degrees of freedom cannot even be exhausted by developers.

== Important Information ==
Due to some misconceptions: This wiki is not official and fan-made. Still if you see  content that does not match the criteria below you can report this in the wiki section of the official [https://discord.gg/Twdt4jnJ Discord Server].

You dont need an account for posting/editing content. Note: You can still get banned via IP-address of this wiki or fandom. Please only publish content if it meets the following criteria:

# Must be in English
# Must be in the right page and in correct format(If you dont know the correct format or you are unsure feel free to ask the mods or in discord)
# Must be correct information about magicraft
# Does not contain offensive content

If you find missing information we would be really thankfull if you add it! If you dont want or cant do it please report it so we can add it.
